name: google-translate
description: Google Cloud Translation (Basic, v2) with an API key: translate text, detect language, list languages

nodes.title: Translate text
nodes.description: Translate texts into one language; [i].translatedText belongs to text[i], with detectedSourceLanguage when source is omitted

text.description: Texts (at most 128 per call, 30k characters recommended)

target.description: Target language (ISO-639 code), e.g. en, id, zh-CN

format.description: text, or html to keep markup (and escape entities)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Detect language
nodes.description: Detect the language of texts; [i] lists {language, confidence} candidates for text[i]

text.description: Texts (at most 128 per call, 30k characters recommended)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List languages
nodes.description: Languages Google Translate supports, with names in the display language

display_language.description: Language for the names, e.g. en

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Cloud Translation API (v2) request
nodes.description: Call any Cloud Translation API (v2) endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/language/translate/v2/languages". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/language/translate/v2/languages"
